comments.author: Joe Oakhart
comments.body:
Compared DSO's planning-review criteria (~/dso_planning_criteria_report.md, digital-service-orchestra @ 2e9eaf4a44) against rebar's plan-review gate (docs/plan-review-gate.md, src/rebar/llm/plan_review/). Full report at ~/dso_rebar_plan_review_gap_report.md, published as Artifact https://claude.ai/code/artifact/a3f2069a-e882-4aa0-99be-bca19ed81b4d.

Synthesis preserves rebar's multi-pass severity-free-finder + typed-binary-verifier + deterministic-decide architecture as intentionally superior (DSO's own bug history — untrusted self-scored status fields, score inflation, skipped gates — validates it).

Gaps DSO catches that rebar doesn't: G-1 no conflict detection between findings; G-2 no oscillation detection across re-review rounds (sidecar norm_id history enables it); G-3 verify-command defect taxonomy + behavioral-command blacklist (grep/ls/cat/test -f = file inspection, not behavior); G-4 OUT-assertion/scope-exclusion false preconditions; G-5 behavioral-prohibition consumer scan; G-6 in-flight cross-ticket interaction scanning; G-7 inference-signal provenance lexicon when no session log linked; G-8 T3 command-surface empiricism (per-command --help, endpoint granularity, env preconditions); G-9 scale grounding + upward-interpolation prohibition; G-10 CI-trigger/release-infra coverage audit; G-11 G3 three-part coverage standard + bypass-annotation patterns; G-12 prompt-injection directive missing from reviewer prompts.

FP-avoidance transfers to Pass 2: new verifier binary respects_artifact_altitude; restatement gloss on no_existing_mitigation; already-standard-practice check; ambiguity-not-absence framing (T5c/T10); one-way blast-radius ratchet.

Reliability: chunk-contamination calibration for the blocking seven (R-1); double-verification agreement for block-crossing findings (R-2); document asymmetric-error directions (R-3); bug-history citations in rubrics (R-4); registry-generated authoring companion (R-5); affirmative-framing audit of packaged prompts (R-6).

Adoption plan: P0 prompt-only (injection directive, verifier binary, G3 standard, E4 lexicon, E6/A1/G6/T5a/T3 enrichments); P1 small code (P6 DET blacklist, conflict pass, oscillation signal, G1G2 prohibition mode, 3 new coach moves, docs); P2 experiments (chunk isolation, double-verify, cross-ticket criterion, T10/T12 CI audit).

Note: an earlier copy of this entry was appended in error to unrelated session log c905-a38c-0419-448e (stale current-log pointer) before rotating to this log.

comments.author: Joe Oakhart
comments.body: Locked the dso->rebar code-review adoption roadmap via one-at-a-time clarification, then created + decomposed epic sure-foyer-aroma (ac1b-cef3-35c8-415f). Key intent decisions (all validated against rebar's architecture to avoid inheriting dso antipatterns): DROP verbatim-excerpt/threshold-invariance/fragility-naming (compensating mechanisms rebar solves via Pass-2 verify + agentic grounding); RELOCATE absence-claim rigor to Pass-2; ADOPT positive linter-deference framing (backed by an in-repo experiment: positive framing gave recall 2.0->2.33 substantive with fewer nits, and DISPROVED the pink-elephant priming fear); ui_artifacts reclassified to a deterministic conflict-marker detector; deletion/asymmetric-change became a content-triggered deletion-impact LLM overlay (grounding oracle has no reverse-reference lookup, so a pure DET version is imprecise new work); tests overlay carries BOTH halves of the behavioral-testing standard (domain rubric stays in the overlay, Pass-2 stays generic) and this principle propagates to all 5 enriched overlays; scope-intent overlay checks the diff vs the UNION of all trailer-referenced tickets (extract_ticket_refs supports multiple ids) so multi-ticket commits don't FP; cross-patchset memory (#6) DEFERRED to its own epic super-path-bag (374d). Structure: 8 stories (A eval-foundation gates B-H; D has 6 overlay tasks with tests-first) + 6 tasks + 14 dependency/provenance links. Experiment harness at ~/.claude/jobs/19885ca3/tmp/nit_framing_exp.py.

comments.author: Joe Oakhart
comments.body: Ran plan-review on epic sure-foyer-aroma (ac1b) + all 14 children. RESULT: all 15 PASS, ZERO BLOCK. Operational note: cross-session rate contention (other bg sessions run review-plan sharing the Anthropic burst limit) caused 429->INDETERMINATE for ~6 children on the concurrent batch and again for A/G/H/D1/D4 on the sequential run; a retry-with-backoff repair pass recovered all to PASS (llm_ran=True). Then applied user-approved remediation of valid advisory findings (Tiers 1-3): set file_impact on all 13 leaves (incl. declaring criteria_routing.json on C/E/F so next_batch serializes those shared-file edits); rewrote 8 descriptions to fold in grounded prerequisites the plans had glossed: (A) eval harness has NO code-review arm in eval_solver.run_case + no code_review_* scorer in eval_scorers.py -> story A must extend the harness before writing specs; (C,E) new overlay ids deletion-impact/scope-intent must be added to the closed OVERLAY_IDS tuple in registry.py or dispatch silently drops them; (E) assemble.py doesn't read the rebar-ticket trailer + ticket_context is shared so ticket-blindness needs real plumbing; (F) engine_b.scan is whole-file+location-postfilter not added-lines-only -> reconcile granularity; softened the pink-elephant 'disproven' overclaim to 'not-supported at n=3, directional'; specified applies_when tag vocab (G), non-trivial-diff threshold (H); defined the epic's measurement baseline (story A records pre-change gate rates). CONSEQUENCE: these material edits invalidate the plan-review attestations for the claim gate on every edited ticket (manifest binds material:a4107ea...; only da8a D-story untouched/valid). Edited tickets need re-review before claim (claim gate enforces this lazily). Full plan-review outputs in ~/.claude/jobs/19885ca3/tmp/planrev/.

comments.author: Joe Oakhart
comments.body: Plan-review of epic sure-foyer-aroma + 14 children COMPLETE: all 15 PASS, 0 BLOCK on the original pass. Applied user-approved Tier 1+2+3 advisory remediation (13 file_impacts, 8 description rewrites incl. eval-harness prereq, OVERLAY_IDS registration, trailer plumbing, detector granularity, softened pink-elephant overclaim, defined baseline). Per user, re-reviewed ONLY story A (eval-foundation) now; deferred the other 13 attestation refreshes to claim-time. A's re-review surfaced a LEGITIMATE BLOCK (G6): the eval output-shape contract was unspecified — eval_scorers._fired() matches only verdict=='FAIL' but the code-review gate emits BLOCK/PASS, so seeded-defect recall cases could vacuously pass. Remediated A's plan to pin the contract (arm runs individual prompts, scores on findings presence/absence, never routes code-review cases through the FAIL-only _fired). Subsequent re-reviews of A (attempts 3,4,5) degraded reproducibly: verdict INDETERMINATE, verify_requests=0, llm_ms~=21ms despite 26 llm_calls, 0x429, EMPTY stderr — Pass-2 verify silently non-dispatches; clearing .rebar/cache (no A entry) didn't help; attempt 1 on the prior plan verified normally (verify_requests=43). Filed as gate-reliability bug turf-purple-dot (4a4c-6fb2-67c8-41d4), discovered_from ac1b. NET: A's plan is remediated + sound; a clean signed attestation is blocked by that anomaly, so A refreshes at claim-time like the other 13. Evidence JSONs in ~/.claude/jobs/19885ca3/tmp/planrev/.
